title: feat(doctor): prose reader for typography rules (#805)
body:
Closes #805

Adds `packages/doctor/src/prose.mjs`, exporting `prose(file)` — the shared input for typography rules. It takes a Markdown string or `{ text, lang }` and returns `{ lang, runs }`, where each run is `{ text, line, column }` with 1-based lines and columns.

Skipped, per the issue:

- front matter (the first `---` block, and `lang:` in it wins over the site language)
- fenced code in both ``` and ~~~ blocks
- inline code spans (the backticks and their contents)
- HTML tags, attributes, and comments
- image syntax and link destinations (link labels stay prose)
- bare URLs (`https:`, `http:`, `mailto:`, `ftp:`, `www.`)
- Liquid tags, outputs, and comments

Heading, blockquote, and list markers are stripped so a run starts at its text; columns stay relative to the source line so they map straight back to the file.

Only the two files the issue lists are touched.

## Tests

`node --test packages/doctor/test/prose.test.mjs` — 11 pass, covering each skipped construct, line numbers after front matter, the `lang:` precedence, and columns from the line start.

`node --test packages/doctor/test/*.test.mjs` — 140 pass.
